LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Scarecrow Searching for Wisdom
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Scarecrow Searching for Wisdom (F-01-87) is a stitched burlap effigy clutching a rusting rake and sickle, endlessly envying the minds of scholars.\nSend anyone with Prudence Level III or above—or suffer a Bad result—and it tears off its hat to harvest the brains of the wise, shrugging off all harm while feeding on fallen victims.
